method.construction: Both variants use one existing Astro production build. Only the seven offer img tags are substituted with their recorded pre-Phase-1 tags in the original variant.

definitions.original: Recorded pre-Phase-1 offer img tags inside the SAME current production document and assets.
definitions.blocking: Third-party attribution audit blocking time over its analysis window; not an exact allocation of the displayed simulated TBT. Do not add it to or subtract it from TBT.
definitions.cpu: Lighthouse bootup/main-thread audit CPU timings under the configured simulated mobile slowdown.
definitions.statistics: Linear-interpolated quartiles and even-sample median. Paired differences are optimized minus original. Bootstrap intervals are exploratory and do not eliminate host/network/remote-script variation.
